Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Request: final invoice cadence and remit for annual prepay

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again — we are ready to finalize the invoicing cadence for our agreed annual prepay. Finance needs a clean schedule and the first invoice to trigger payment. Can you confirm: the initial upfront invoice amount, subsequent sweep windows (monthly or quarterly), and whether Redwood will include VAT on each invoice or we should handle reverse-charge treatment?

Also please attach the finalized invoice schedule and the signed SOW so our AP can create the PO and route payments. Our preferred remit email is ap@greenfield.ai and the vendor onboarding team needs the remit instructions attached.

PO will be raised once we receive the schedule and the invoice for the initial payment.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — target to originate the first invoice by 7/17 if possible.

Regards,
Maya Turner
Head of Finance Operations
Greenfield Analytics
[External]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: final invoice cadence and remit for annual prepay

Hi Maya — thanks for the note. Draft schedule and notes below; attaching GF-Invoice_Schedule_v3.xlsx and the Signed-SOW-GF.pdf for your AP.

Summary (proposal based on the SOW):
- Total committed prepay: USD 600,000 for 12 months (starts 2025-08-01).
- Initial upfront invoice (Month 0): 200,000 USD (covers setup & first two months of committed capacity).
- Monthly sweep: 33,333.33 USD on the 1st of each month, starting 2025-10-01, until the remaining balance is consumed (10 months at ~33,333.33).
- Alternative: Quarterly billing option (3 x 133,333.33) if AP prefers fewer invoices — indicate preference.

VAT handling:
- For US billing to Greenfield US entity, we will not apply VAT.
- For EU-registered Greenfield entities we will issue invoices with net amounts and include VAT number fields for reverse-charge as appropriate. Please confirm the legal entity and VAT number the PO will reference.

Remit & PO requirements we need from you to finalize:
1) PO number and exact legal entity name to put on the invoice.
2) Remit address and whether wire vs ACH is preferred (AP email is fine).
3) Any required invoice reference (internal cost center or project code).

Attachments: [Attachment: GF-Invoice_Schedule_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: Signed-SOW-GF.pdf (pdf)].

Action: If this schedule works I will issue the initial invoice on 7/17 and send to ap@greenfield.ai with the attachments. If Karthik/Neha have any tax or ledger tweaks I'll incorporate now.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Quick tax note — a couple of small asks to make AP's life easier:
- Add a separate column in the schedule for "VAT applicability" (Y/N) and "VAT rate" to avoid back-and-forth when the invoice lands.
- For EU entities: include our UK/EU VAT registration details in the invoice footer and the phrase "Reverse charge applies per EU Council Directive" when the customer is VAT-registered.
- For wire instructions, include both Swift and IBAN for EUR accounts; for USD we can provide ACH routing.

I'll update the template and attach a small snippet of the footer we use. If you want I can produce the VAT-ready copy before sending to Greenfield.

Karthik
